requirements.title: Outline a file at a ref
requirements.rationale: Knowing what a file declares, and where, is what an agent reads first; it should cost one request and no clone.

criteria.condition: a caller requests GET /workspaces/:slug/scm/outline with the path of a source file in a supported language
criteria.action: answer with the file's declarations in line order, each with its kind, name, container, signature, whether it is exported, and its first and last line, and with the commit the ref resolved to
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with {"path", "resolved_sha", "language", "supported": true, "declarations": [{"kind", "name", "container", "signature", "exported", "start_line", "end_line"}]}; kind is one of func, method, type, class, interface, enum, trait, const, var, module, macro; lines are 1-based; declarations is [] for a file that declares nothing, never null

setup: a workspace whose main holds router.go, a Go file with a constant, a type with a method, an exported and an unexported function, and empty.go, a Go file with a package clause alone
check.pseudocode: in a new internal/scm/outline_test.go, with the hub and repository helpers of internal/scm/helpers_test.go: r = GET …/scm/outline?path=router.go; r.status == 200; r.path == "router.go"; r.resolved_sha == head of main; r.language == "Go"; r.supported == true; declarations, in order, equal the file's {kind, name, container, signature, exported, start_line, end_line}, the method with its type as container; start_line rises; GET of empty.go answers supported true and declarations == []

criteria.action: outline the file as it is at that ref: a branch, a tag, a full or abbreviated commit id, or a hub-owned ref, on a repository or on a fork's own refs, and without a ref at the workspace's default branch, a fork's base branch

check.pseudocode: in internal/scm/outline_test.go, as TestFile_ReadsTheCommitItsRefNames does for the file route: the file differs between main, the branch feat, the tag v1 and the first commit; a table over ref {absent, main, feat, v1, the first commit's id, its 8-character form}: resolved_sha and the declarations are those of that commit; on a fork (as in internal/scm/fork_test.go), ref absent outlines the fork's base branch and ref = the fork's own branch outlines the fork's file

criteria.condition: the file is in a language this build of the hub has no backend for, or in no known language
criteria.action: answer that the file is not supported, with no declarations, and not as an error
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with supported: false, declarations: [], language the language's name where the extension is known and "" otherwise

check.pseudocode: in internal/scm/outline_test.go, a table over files of main {README.md, data.csv, Makefile, a file without an extension}: 200, supported == false, declarations == [], language == ""

criteria.condition: the path names a symbolic link
criteria.action: answer that the link is not supported, without following it
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with supported: false, language: "", declarations: []; the link's target is not read

check.pseudocode: in internal/scm/outline_test.go: main holds link.go, a symbolic link to router.go; GET …/scm/outline?path=link.go answers 200 with supported false, language "" and no declarations

criteria.action: for any file in Go, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C#, Ruby, C, C++, PHP, Scala, Lua or Shell, outline it with supported: true when the hub is built with cgo

setup: the test binary is built with cgo; the test file carries the build constraint cgo, since without it only Go has a backend
check.pseudocode: in a new internal/scm/outline_cgo_test.go, a table of one small file per language (a.py, a.js, a.ts, a.rs, A.java, a.kt, A.cs, a.rb, a.c, a.cpp, a.php, a.scala, a.lua, a.sh, each declaring one function or class named greet or Greeter): GET …/scm/outline answers supported true, language the language's name, and a declaration with that name and a start_line of at least 1

requirements.title: Refuse what cannot be outlined, and follow the conventions of the reads
requirements.rationale: The outline is one more read of the source control API: a caller that knows the file route knows its errors, its access rule and its caching.

criteria.condition: the request has no path, or a path the file route refuses: absolute, with an empty, . or .. segment, under .git, or holding a NUL character
criteria.action: refuse the request without opening the repository's objects
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with error_type invalid_request and the file route's message for the same path

check.pseudocode: in internal/scm/outline_test.go, a table over path {absent, "", "/a.go", "a//b.go", "../a.go", ".git/config"}: 400 invalid_request, and the message equals the one GET …/scm/file answers for the same path

criteria.condition: the ref names no commit, or the path does not exist at the ref
criteria.action: refuse the request as the file route does
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with error_type ref_not_found for the ref, and 404 with error_type path_not_found for the path

check.pseudocode: in internal/scm/outline_test.go: ref=nope answers 404 ref_not_found; path=nope.go answers 404 path_not_found; a path that exists on feat and not on main answers 404 without a ref and 200 with ref=feat

criteria.condition: the path names a directory or a submodule
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with error_type invalid_request and a message that says the path is not a file

check.pseudocode: in internal/scm/outline_test.go: path=internal, a directory of main, answers 400 invalid_request

criteria.condition: the file is larger than 1 MiB
criteria.action: refuse the request before any of the file is read
criteria.contract: HTTP 413 with error_type payload_too_large and the member size, the file's size in bytes; a file of exactly 1 MiB is outlined

check.pseudocode: in internal/scm/outline_test.go: big.go of 1<<20 + 1 bytes answers 413 payload_too_large with size == 1048577; edge.go of exactly 1<<20 bytes, a valid Go file padded with a comment, answers 200

criteria.condition: the file is binary: its first 8,000 bytes hold a NUL byte
criteria.action: refuse the request without parsing the file
criteria.contract: HTTP 422 with error_type binary_file and a message naming the path

check.pseudocode: in internal/scm/outline_test.go, a table {logo.png with a NUL in its header, blob.go whose third byte is NUL}: 422 binary_file; a .go file whose only NUL is at byte 9,000 is not refused as binary

criteria.action: end the read and answer as every source control read does
criteria.contract: HTTP 503 with error_type scm_timeout and none of the caching headers

check.pseudocode: in internal/scm/timeout_test.go, the outline route added to the table of TestRead_EndsAReadThatOutlastsTheReadTimeout: 503 scm_timeout

criteria.action: for any successful answer, give the caching headers of the source control reads: immutable when the ref was written as a full commit id, otherwise an entity tag to revalidate with, and answer a request whose If-None-Match holds the tag 304 without reading the file

check.pseudocode: in internal/scm/cache_test.go, the outline route added to the tables of TestRead_MarksAnAnswerAddressedByFullIdsImmutable, TestRead_AnswersAnyOtherReadWithATagToRevalidate, TestRead_AnswersNotModifiedToAnIfNoneMatchHoldingItsTag, TestRead_AnswersNotModifiedWithoutTheReadsCostlyPart and TestRead_LeavesAnErrorWithoutATagAndUncached; the tag changes when main moves and when the path changes

criteria.action: for any request to the route, apply the access rule of the source control reads (a PAT needs git:read, the caller read access to the workspace, a fork's reader reads the fork) and report the request once to parley_scm_requests_total under the op outline

check.pseudocode: the outline route added to the tables of internal/scm/access_test.go (TestRead_ServesEveryReaderOnEveryReadableWorkspace, TestRead_RefusesACallerWhoMayNotReadWithoutOpeningTheRepository, TestRead_RefusesAWorkspaceThatIsNotReadableWithoutOpeningTheRepository) and of internal/scm/recorder_test.go (TestRead_ReportsEachRequestOnceToTheRecorder, under the op outline with the results the other reads report), all through one new row of the table scmRoutes of internal/scm/helpers_test.go; in internal/metrics/catalogue_test.go the documented values of the label op of parley_scm_requests_total gain outline

requirements.title: Outline from the shell, as a tool, and in the hub image
requirements.rationale: The operation reaches an agent as a command and as a tool, and the image an operator runs outlines every language of the list.

criteria.condition: parley scm outline <slug> <path> is run, with or without --ref
criteria.action: send one GET to the outline route with path and, when given, ref, and print the hub's answer
criteria.contract: one request GET /api/v1/workspaces/<slug>/scm/outline?path=…[&ref=…]; stdout is the answer as one JSON document; exit status 0; the hub's error envelope on stderr and exit status 1 for a refusal

check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/scm_test.go, rows added to the table of TestSCM_ReadsSendOneGetAndPrintTheAnswer: {scm outline demo internal/api/router.go → scm/outline?path=internal%2Fapi%2Frouter.go; with --ref v1 → path=…&ref=v1}

criteria.condition: parley scm outline is run without a slug or without a path, or with a third argument
criteria.action: refuse the command line before any request
criteria.contract: one usage_error envelope on stderr; exit status 2; no request sent

check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/scm_test.go, rows added to the table of TestSCM_RefusesABadCommandLineBeforeAnyRequest: {scm outline, scm outline demo, scm outline demo a.go b.go}

criteria.action: for any session of parley mcp that serves the group scm, serve the command as the tool scm_outline, in a read-only session too

check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/mcp_test.go, beside TestMCPList_PrintsTheDefaultSelectionAsTools: mcp --list and mcp --read-only --list hold scm_outline with the required string parameters slug and path and the optional string ref

criteria.action: for any build of the hub image, hold a parleyd built with cgo, which outlines the fifteen languages, beside a parley built without cgo

setup: a container engine, as the image tests need; they skip without one
check.pseudocode: in test/image/hub_test.go, a subtest of TestHubImage_RunsTheHubOnOneVolume: a git repository with a.py is made inside the container with the image's git, a workspace is created from it through the hub's API with the admin token, and GET …/scm/outline?path=a.py answers supported true with the function a.py declares; `parley version` of the image's parley exits 0

execution_paths.title: An agent outlines a file before it forks

steps.action: runs parley scm outline demo internal/api/router.go
sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/demo/scm/outline?path=internal/api/router.go with the agent's credential
checks the credential and read access, resolves the default branch, reads the file's bytes from the repository and outlines them
prints the declarations with their kinds, signatures and lines
runs the command again with --ref on a branch that changed the file and reads the declarations of that commit

real_components: the source control component with a real repository
setup: the hub of the source control read tests of test/e2e/scm_read_test.go, whose demo holds internal/api/router.go on main and a changed copy on the branch feat, and app.py
end_state: the first command printed the declarations of main's router.go with resolved_sha main's head, NewRouter among them with its line
the second printed those of feat's copy, with the function feat added
parley scm outline demo app.py printed supported true and the function the file declares
each command exited 0 and the hub's metrics count three requests under op outline
smoke.pseudocode: a new test in test/e2e/scm_read_test.go beside TestSCMRead_AnAgentReadsAFileByNameThenByIdThenADiff: run the three commands through cli.Run against the hub and assert the end state; the Python row needs the test binary built with cgo
